assignedReviews.reason: The card is about visible light and rainbows, unrelated to solutions, solutes, or solvents. It does not support identifying the role of solute and solvent in a solution.

copy.en: Visible light allows us to see the world around us, and it is the part of the electromagnetic spectrum that creates rainbows when sunlight passes through raindrops.
copy.tl: Ang visible light ang nagbibigay-daan sa atin para makita ang mundo sa paligid natin, at ito ang bahagi ng electromagnetic spectrum na lumilikha ng bahaghari kapag dumaan ang sikat ng araw sa mga patak ng ulan.
copy.bis: Ang visible light maoy nagtugot kanato sa pagtan-aw sa kalibotan sa atong palibut, ug kini ang parte sa electromagnetic spectrum nga naghimo sa balangaw kon moagi ang kahayag sa adlaw sa mga tulo sa ulan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Philippines has 65 seismic stations

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about seismic stations, not weather characteristics such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, humidity, rain, or cloud cover. No weather-related content is present.

copy.en: The Philippines has 65 seismic stations, with 29 manned stations, 30 unmanned stations, and 6 volcano stations all sending data to PHIVOLCS.
copy.tl: Ang Pilipinas ay may 65 seismic stations, kung saan 29 ang manned, 30 ang unmanned, at 6 ang volcano stations na lahat ay nagpapadala ng data sa PHIVOLCS.
copy.bis: Ang Pilipinas adunay 65 ka seismic stations, diin 29 ang manned, 30 ang unmanned, ug 6 ang volcano stations nga tanan nagpadala ug data sa PHIVOLCS.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: examine a local weather chart to make simple interpretations about the local weather and describe and practice safety precautions to use during poor or extreme weather conditions
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes seismic waves and seismographs, which are related to earthquakes, not weather. It provides no information about examining a local weather chart, interpreting local weather, or safety precautions for poor/extreme weather.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Seismic waves are waves of energy that travel through or near the Earth's surface
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify some of the basic characteristics used to describe the weather, such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, rain, and cloud cover
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about seismic waves, not weather characteristics such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, humidity, rain, or cloud cover. It does not support identifying basic weather characteristics.

copy.en: Seismic waves are waves of energy that travel through or near the Earth's surface and are recorded by instruments called seismographs.
copy.tl: Ang seismic waves ay mga alon ng enerhiya na naglalakbay sa loob o malapit sa surface ng Earth at nire-record ng mga instrumentong tinatawag na seismographs.
copy.bis: Ang seismic waves mao ang mga balod sa enerhiya nga mobiyahe sa ilawom o duol sa surface sa Earth ug gina-record sa mga instrumento nga gitawag ug seismographs.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A receptor detects a change, and an effector acts to fix it
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain why physical changes are reversible, and chemical changes are irreversible
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes receptor-effector coordination, a biological control mechanism, and has no content about physical vs chemical changes or reversibility/irreversibility.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A receptor detects a change, and an effector acts to fix it
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how changes in solid materials make them useful, such as when they are shaped, pressed, hammered, joined, or cut
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not describe changes in solid materials or how shaping, pressing, hammering, joining, or cutting make them useful; it is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: A receptor detects a change, and an effector acts to fix it, working together like a sensor and a switch in a machine.
copy.tl: Ang receptor ay nakaka-detect ng pagbabago, at ang effector ay kumikilos para ayusin ito, nagtutulungan tulad ng sensor at switch sa isang makina.
copy.bis: Ang receptor makadetect ug kausaban, ug ang effector molihok aron ayohon kini, magtinabangay sama sa sensor ug switch sa usa ka makina.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Chromatography separates dissolved substances
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: refer to the local disaster readiness plans to demonstrate what to do during and after an earthquake
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains chromatography, a technique for separating colored dissolved substances. The assigned competency G7-E-6 concerns referring to local disaster readiness plans for earthquake preparedness. There is no overlap in subject matter; the card does not support the competency in any way.

copy.en: Chromatography separates dissolved substances that have different colors, like inks and plant dyes, based on how easily each component is drawn across the surface of another material.
copy.tl: Ang chromatography ay naghihiwalay ng mga natunaw na substance na may iba't ibang kulay, tulad ng mga tinta at pangkulay ng halaman, batay sa kung gaano kadaling madala ang bawat sangkap sa ibabaw ng isa pang materyal.
copy.bis: Ang chromatography mobulag sa mga natunaw nga substance nga adunay lain-laing kolor, sama sa mga tinta ug pangkolor sa tanom, base sa kung unsa kadali madala ang matag sangkap sa ibabaw sa laing materyal.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Mixtures can be separated by physical means
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how energy from the Sun interacts with the atmosphere
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about separating mixtures by physical means, which is a chemistry/matter topic. It provides no information about how energy from the Sun interacts with the atmosphere.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Mixtures can be separated by physical means
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe some of the overall characteristics of the Sun, such as its composition, its size, and the main energy it radiates
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses physical separation of mixtures and does not describe any characteristics of the Sun such as composition, size, or radiated energy.

copy.en: Mixtures can be separated by physical means, like using your hands, a filter, or a sieve, without changing the substances themselves.
copy.tl: Ang mga mixture ay maaaring paghiwalayin sa pisikal na paraan, tulad ng paggamit ng kamay, filter, o sieve, nang hindi binabago ang mismong mga sangkap.
copy.bis: Ang mga mixture mahimong bulagon pinaagi sa pisikal nga paagi, sama sa paggamit sa kamot, filter, o sieve, nga dili usbon ang mismong mga sangkap.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Series circuits need fewer wiring connections
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the chemical properties of materials, such as they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes series circuit wiring and current pathways, which is electricity content. It provides no information about chemical properties of materials such as burning, reacting, or biodegradability.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: every part must work for the circuit to work
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate proper handling and disposal of materials according to their properties, such as reusing objects, disposing of excess oil into garbage, and recycling paper, plastic or glass
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about series circuit behavior, not about proper handling, disposal, reusing, or recycling of materials according to their properties.

copy.en: Series circuits need fewer wiring connections, but they have only one pathway for current, so every part must work for the circuit to work.
copy.tl: Ang series circuit ay nangangailangan ng mas kaunting wiring connections, pero iisa lang ang daanan ng current, kaya dapat gumana ang bawat bahagi para gumana ang circuit.
copy.bis: Ang series circuit nagkinahanglan ug mas diyutay nga wiring connections, apan usa ra ang agianan sa current, busa kinahanglang molihok ang matag parte aron molihok ang circuit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A severe tropical storm is a tropical cyclone
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a severe tropical storm (a weather phenomenon) and gives wind speed criteria. It contains no information about solutes, solvents, or solutions, so it does not support the competency in any way.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A severe tropical storm is a tropical cyclone
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about tropical cyclones, not about uniform or non-uniform mixtures, solutions, or suspensions. It is entirely unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: A severe tropical storm is a tropical cyclone with maximum wind speed of 89 to 117 kilometers per hour, and it looks more organized and circular.
copy.tl: Ang severe tropical storm ay isang tropical cyclone na may maximum wind speed na 89 hanggang 117 kilometers per hour, at mas organized at pabilog ang anyo nito.
copy.bis: Ang severe tropical storm usa ka tropical cyclone nga adunay maximum wind speed nga 89 hangtod 117 kilometers per hour, ug mas organized ug lingin ang porma.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: a sperm cell from a pollen grain unites with an egg cell inside the ovule
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the formation of ions as either the loss or gain of electrons to produce ionic bonds, using examples, such as the formation of sodium chloride
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes sexual reproduction in flowering plants (fertilization of egg by sperm). G9-M-5 requires explaining ion formation via loss/gain of electrons to produce ionic bonds, e.g., sodium chloride. There is no overlap in subject matter; the card does not support the competency.

copy.en: Flowering plants reproduce sexually when a sperm cell from a pollen grain unites with an egg cell inside the ovule.
copy.tl: Ang mga halamang namumulaklak ay nagpaparami nang sekswal kapag ang sperm cell mula sa pollen grain ay nakikipag-isa sa egg cell sa loob ng ovule.
copy.bis: Ang mga tanom nga namulak mosanay pinaagi sa sekswal nga paagi kon ang sperm cell gikan sa pollen grain moipon sa egg cell sa sulod sa ovule.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: During an earthquake, the strongest shaking occurs at the epicenter
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe the possible effects of human activities, such as deforestation, pollution, and introduction of invasive species, on living things in an ecosystem
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes earthquake shaking at the epicenter, a geology/earth science topic. It provides no information about human activities (deforestation, pollution, invasive species) affecting living things in an ecosystem.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: During an earthquake, the strongest shaking occurs at the epicenter
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how interaction between living things and interactions between living and non-living things may bring good or harm to the living things involved
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about earthquake epicenter and focus, not about interactions between living and non-living things bringing good or harm. It does not address any biotic/abiotic interaction or ecosystem harm.

copy.en: During an earthquake, the strongest shaking occurs at the epicenter, the surface point directly above the focus.
copy.tl: Sa panahon ng lindol, ang pinakamalakas na pagyanig ay nangyayari sa epicenter, ang punto sa surface na direktang nasa itaas ng focus.
copy.bis: Sa panahon sa linog, ang pinakakusog nga pag-uyog mahitabo sa epicenter, ang punto sa surface nga direkta sa taas sa focus.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A shallow focus means the rock breaks closer to the surface, so the shaking at the epicenter can be much stronger.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: carry out guided investigations to describe and illustrate the reflection of light using plane and curved mirrors and the refraction of light using transparent blocks, lenses, and prisms with examples from everyday applications
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes earthquake focus depth and shaking intensity, which is Earth science content. G8-F-11 requires guided investigations on reflection and refraction of light using mirrors, lenses, and prisms. There is no overlap in subject matter.

copy.en: A shallow focus means the rock breaks closer to the surface, so the shaking at the epicenter can be much stronger.
copy.tl: Ang mababaw na focus ay nangangahulugang mas malapit sa surface nababali ang bato, kaya mas malakas ang pagyanig sa epicenter.
copy.bis: Ang mabaw nga focus nagpasabot nga ang bato mabali duol sa surface, mao nga mas kusog ang pag-uyog sa epicenter.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Solar System is a disk-shaped system made of the Sun, eight planets, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and meteors.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the shape and composition of the Solar System. It contains no information about plant outer parts (leaves, roots, stems) or their roles in water and nutrient uptake. The competency is about plant anatomy, which is entirely unrelated to the card content.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Solar System is a disk-shaped system made of the Sun, eight planets, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and meteors.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the root and shoot system in plants and describe why they are important
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the Solar System, not about the root and shoot system of plants. It provides no support for observing or describing plant root and shoot systems. The competency is unrelated to the card content.

copy.en: The Solar System is a disk-shaped system made of the Sun, eight planets, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and meteors.
copy.tl: Ang Solar System ay hugis-disk na sistema na binubuo ng Sun, walong planeta, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids, comets, at meteors.
copy.bis: Ang Solar System usa ka disk-shaped nga sistema nga gilangkuban sa Sun, walo ka planeta, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids, comets, ug meteors.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Faulting and folding are two processes that shape Earth's geological surface
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate how different factors affect the solubility of a solute in a given solvent, such as heat
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes geological processes (faulting and folding) shaping Earth's surface. G7-M-10 is about demonstrating factors affecting solubility of a solute in a solvent, such as heat. There is no connection to solubility, solutes, solvents, or heat affecting solubility. The tag is unrelated to the card content.

copy.en: Faulting and folding are two processes that shape Earth's geological surface by breaking or bending rocks in the lithosphere.
copy.tl: Ang faulting at folding ay dalawang proseso na humuhubog sa geological surface ng Earth sa pamamagitan ng pagbasag o pagbaluktot ng mga bato sa lithosphere.
copy.bis: Ang faulting ug folding duha ka proseso nga naghulma sa geological surface sa Earth pinaagi sa pagbuak o pagbaluktot sa mga bato sa lithosphere.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the roles of producers, consumers, scavengers, and decomposers in a food web
assignedReviews.reason: Sharing recycling ideas is unrelated to producers, consumers, scavengers, and decomposers in a food web.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: consult with DENR personnel about proper waste management
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the process of photosynthesis and respiration, and identify its raw materials needed and products
assignedReviews.reason: Civic recycling advice is unrelated to photosynthesis and respiration and their raw materials and products.

copy.en: Share your recycling interest and experience with neighbors and barangay officials, and consult with DENR personnel about proper waste management.
copy.tl: Ibahagi ang iyong interes at karanasan sa pag-recycle sa mga kapitbahay at opisyal ng barangay, at kumonsulta sa mga tauhan ng DENR tungkol sa tamang pamamahala ng basura.
copy.bis: Ipaambit ang imong interes ug kasinatian sa pag-recycle sa mga silingan ug opisyal sa barangay, ug mokonsulta sa mga personahe sa DENR mahitungod sa husto nga pagdumala sa basura.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: heat can't destroy it
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes in properties of materials when exposed to certain changes in temperature, such as changes when wood or coal are burned
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses red tide toxin in shellfish and that cooking/heat does not remove it. This is a food-safety/biological toxin topic, not a description of changes in properties of materials when exposed to temperature (e.g., burning wood or coal). No direct or prerequisite support for the competency.

copy.en:
Does cooking remove red tide poison?

No! Cooking mussels does NOT remove red tide poison — heat can't destroy it, so never eat shellfish during a red tide warning.
copy.tl:
Naaalis ba ng luto ang lason ng red tide?

Hindi! Hindi naaalis ng pagluluto ang lason ng red tide sa tahong — hindi ito naaalis ng init, kaya bawal talaga kumain ng shellfish tuwing may babala ng red tide.
copy.bis:
Makuha ba sa luto ang hilo sa red tide?

Dili! Dili makuha sa pagluto ang hilo sa red tide sa tahong — dili kini mawala sa kainit, mao nga dili gyud angay mokaon og shellfish kung adunay pasidaan sa red tide.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Shield volcanoes can grow to be very big
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain why ancient human cultures relied on constellations to indicate directions and verify seasons
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the shape and size of shield volcanoes, which is unrelated to the competency about ancient cultures using constellations for directions and seasons.

copy.en: Shield volcanoes can grow to be very big, with a tall broad and flat rounded shape, low slopes, and large craters, like Mauna Loa in Hawaii.
copy.tl: Ang shield volcanoes ay maaaring lumaki nang napakalaki, may malapad at patag na bilugang hugis, mababang slope, at malalaking crater, tulad ng Mauna Loa sa Hawaii.
copy.bis: Ang shield volcanoes mahimong motubo nga dako kaayo, nga adunay lapad ug patag nga lingin nga porma, ubos nga slope, ug dagkong crater, sama sa Mauna Loa sa Hawaii.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Wearing shoes prevents cuts and wounds on our feet.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use models or illustrations to explain how movements along faults generate earthquakes and identify and explain which types of faults are most likely to occur in the Philippines and explain why
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about protecting skin by wearing shoes; it contains no information about faults, earthquakes, or Philippine fault types, so it does not support the assigned Earth/space competency.

copy.en:
Why wear shoes outside?

Skin protects the body from injuries, but we must also protect our skin! Wearing shoes prevents cuts and wounds on our feet.
copy.tl:
Bakit magsuot ng sapatos sa labas?

Pinoprotektahan ng balat ang katawan mula sa mga sugat, ngunit dapat din nating protektahan ang ating balat! Ang pagsusuot ng sapatos ay pumipigil sa mga hiwa at sugat sa ating mga paa.
copy.bis:
Ngano magsul-ob og sapatos sa gawas?

Ang panit nagpanalipod sa lawas batok sa mga samad, apan kinahanglan usab natong panalipdan ang atong panit! Ang pagsul-ob og sapatos makapugong sa mga samad sa atong mga tiil.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Short wavelength X-rays can penetrate through metals
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: gather information from secondary sources to describe and explain what mechanisms that drive the movement of tectonic plates including the role of the asthenosphere
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses X-ray penetration and airport security scanners, which is physics/electromagnetic radiation content. It has no relation to tectonic plate movement mechanisms or the asthenosphere.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Short wavelength X-rays can penetrate through metals
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how the subduction of an oceanic plate impacts on the plate above it
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about X-rays and security scanning, not about subduction of oceanic plates or its impact on the overriding plate. Entirely unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Short wavelength X-rays can penetrate through metals, which is why they are used in airport security scanners to see inside luggage and packages.
copy.tl: Ang short wavelength X-rays ay kayang tumagos sa mga metal, kaya ginagamit ang mga ito sa airport security scanners para makita ang loob ng mga bagahe at pakete.
copy.bis: Ang short wavelength X-rays makalusot sa mga metal, busa gigamit kini sa airport security scanners aron makita ang sulod sa mga bagahe ug pakete.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Sickle cell anemia results from a substitution mutation
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and labeled diagrams the parts of the female reproductive system as ovaries, uterus, and vagina and those of the male reproductive system as the prostate, testis, and penis and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about a DNA substitution mutation causing sickle cell anemia, which is genetics content. G5-L-3 requires identifying and describing the parts of the male and female reproductive systems from pictures/diagrams. The card provides no information about ovaries, uterus, vagina, prostate, testis, or penis, and does not support the competency.

copy.en:
How can one tiny DNA change cause a disease?

Sickle cell anemia results from a substitution mutation that swaps one base, placing a different amino acid in hemoglobin and changing the shape of red blood cells.
copy.tl:
Paano nagdudulot ng sakit ang isang maliit na pagbabago sa DNA?

Ang sickle cell anemia ay resulta ng substitution mutation na nagpapalit ng isang base, kaya ibang amino acid ang nailagay sa hemoglobin at nagbago ang hugis ng red blood cells.
copy.bis:
Giunsa pagpahinabo sa sakit ang usa ka gamay nga pagbag-o sa DNA?

Ang sickle cell anemia resulta sa substitution mutation nga nag-ilis sa usa ka base, busa lain nga amino acid ang nabutang sa hemoglobin ug nausab ang porma sa red blood cells.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: During Storm Signal No. 4, many large trees are uprooted, and residential buildings of mixed construction may be severely damaged.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate proper handling and disposal of materials according to their properties, such as reusing objects, disposing of excess oil into garbage, and recycling paper, plastic or glass
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the destructive effects of Storm Signal No. 4 (uprooted trees, severe building damage). The competency G3-M-7 requires demonstrating proper handling and disposal of materials according to their properties (reusing, disposing of excess oil, recycling). The card provides no instruction or support for material handling/disposal; it is entirely about weather hazard effects, which is unrelated to the matter-handling competency.

copy.en: During Storm Signal No. 4, many large trees are uprooted, and residential buildings of mixed construction may be severely damaged.
copy.tl: Sa Storm Signal No. 4, maraming malalaking puno ang nabubunot, at ang mga gusaling tirahan na may halong materyales ay maaaring malubhang masira.
copy.bis: Sa Storm Signal No. 4, daghan nga dagko nga kahoy ang mangabunot, ug ang mga balay nga sinagol ang materyales mahimong grabe nga maguba.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Dull trees, scattered litter, and dirty water are signs that an environment has a problem
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and diagrams the parts of the respiratory system as the nose, windpipe, and lungs, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes observable signs of environmental problems (dull trees, litter, dirty water). It does not address the respiratory system, its parts (nose, windpipe, lungs), or how they work, which is the exact subject of G5-L-2.

copy.en: Dull trees, scattered litter, and dirty water are signs that an environment has a problem that people can observe and act on.
copy.tl: Ang mga mapurol na puno, kalat na nakakalat, at maruming tubig ay mga senyales na may problema ang kapaligiran na puwedeng obserbahan at aksyunan ng mga tao.
copy.bis: Ang mga dull nga kahoy, nagkatag nga basura, ug hugaw nga tubig mga timailhan nga ang kinaiyahan adunay problema nga mahimong obserbahan ug aksyunan sa mga tao.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The amount of silica in magma controls how a volcano erupts
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains how silica content in magma influences eruption style (quiet flows vs. explosive blasts). This is about volcanoes, not the general structure of the solar system, its celestial objects, or their composition. The competency is entirely unrelated to the card's content.

copy.en: The amount of silica in magma controls how a volcano erupts: low silica gives quiet flows, while high silica traps gas and causes explosive blasts.
copy.tl: Ang dami ng silica sa magma ang kumokontrol kung paano pumuputok ang bulkan: ang mababang silica ay nagbibigay ng tahimik na pag-agos, habang ang mataas na silica ay nakakakulong ng gas at nagdudulot ng marahas na pagsabog.
copy.bis: Ang gidaghanon sa silica sa magma mao ang nagkontrol kung giunsa mobuto ang bulkan: ang ubos nga silica nagahatag ug hilom nga pag-agos, samtang ang taas nga silica nagatrap sa gas ug nagapahinabo ug kusog nga pagbuto.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: cannot interbreed because of behavioral isolation
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: draw diagrams of and assemble series and parallel circuits, showing switch, battery, loads/resistors, ammeter, and voltmeter
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses behavioral isolation and species definition in meadowlarks, which is biology. G9-F-8 requires drawing and assembling series/parallel circuits with electrical components. No electrical circuit content is present.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: cannot interbreed because of behavioral isolation
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: assemble and draw a simple circuit using batteries, wires, switch, and bulb and/or toy motor or buzzer
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about bird species and behavioral isolation, not about assembling or drawing simple circuits. G5-F-8 is a physics competency on simple electrical circuits, which is unrelated to the card content.

copy.en: Eastern and Western meadowlarks look very similar morphologically but cannot interbreed because of behavioral isolation, showing that appearance alone does not define a species.
copy.tl: Ang Eastern at Western meadowlark ay magkamukhang-mukha sa morphological na anyo pero hindi maaaring mag-interbreed dahil sa behavioral isolation, na nagpapakita na hindi sapat ang itsura para tukuyin ang isang species.
copy.bis: Ang Eastern ug Western meadowlark pareho kaayo og morphological nga dagway apan dili makahimo sa pag-interbreed tungod sa behavioral isolation, nga nagpakita nga ang dagway lamang dili igo sa pagtino sa usa ka species.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use a drawing or diagram to classify some Philippine animals and plants, based on their habitat: some live on land (terrestrial), live in water (aquatic) or fly in the air (aerial)
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the parts of a simple electrical circuit. It has no content about Philippine animals or plants, habitats, or classification, and does not use a drawing or diagram as required by the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A simple circuit includes a battery as the power source, wires as connectors, a switch to open or close the path, and an output device such as a bulb, toy motor, or buzzer.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about electrical circuit components, not about the basic needs of living things such as air, food, water, and shelter. It provides no instructional support for this competency.

copy.en: A simple circuit includes a battery as the power source, wires as connectors, a switch to open or close the path, and an output device such as a bulb, toy motor, or buzzer.
copy.tl: Ang isang simple circuit ay binubuo ng battery bilang power source, wires bilang connectors, switch para buksan o isara ang daanan, at output device tulad ng bulb, toy motor, o buzzer.
